faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setup, privacy and Pro.

items.question: What happens when someone tries to unlock my phone?
items.answer: CrookCatcher takes an intruder selfie with the front camera, records GPS location if available, and emails these to you. With Pro, it can also record video, use the back camera, play alarms, and show a fake home screen.

items.question: When does CrookCatcher take action?
items.answer: You can configure how many failed unlock attempts (wrong PIN, pattern or password) are required before CrookCatcher activates. Once that threshold is reached, it takes photos, records videos (Pro), and sends alerts based on your settings.

items.question: What features are included in the free version?
items.answer: The free version includes an intruder selfie on wrong PIN, pattern or password, GPS location, and instant email alerts with the photo and location.

items.question: What additional features does Pro offer?
items.answer: Pro includes video with sound, Google Drive backup, back camera photos, lock screen warning messages, alarm sounds, fake home screen, app lock, disguised icon, break-in detection, custom email subjects, hidden notifications, and removes ads.

items.question: How much does CrookCatcher Pro cost?
items.answer: The price of CrookCatcher Pro varies depending on your country of residence. You can see the exact price for your region directly inside the app.

items.question: How do I access the captured photos and videos?
items.answer: All photos and videos are stored locally on your device and can be viewed in the app. They are also sent to your email automatically. Pro users can additionally upload files to Google Drive for access from any device.

items.question: Does it work without internet?
items.answer: Yes. CrookCatcher will take intruder selfies and store them locally, then send alerts once an internet connection is restored.

items.question: How does CrookCatcher stay discreet?
items.answer: Pro features help keep the app hidden by disguising the app icon, hiding notifications until unlock, customizing email subjects, and locking the app itself with a pattern.

items.question: How does the break-in detection work? (Pro)
items.answer: If someone fails PIN, pattern or password attempts but eventually guesses correctly, break-in detection still takes photos and sends alerts so you catch thieves who manage to unlock the phone.

items.question: Can I customize the alert notifications?
items.answer: Pro users can customize email subjects, hide notifications until the phone is unlocked, and display a custom message on the lock screen when an alert is triggered.

items.question: Will CrookCatcher drain my battery?
items.answer: No. CrookCatcher only activates when a wrong PIN, pattern or password is detected, using minimal battery in standby.

items.question: Is my privacy protected?
items.answer: CrookCatcher only captures photos and videos during failed unlock attempts. Alerts are sent from your own Gmail account — we never see your photos. Analytics help improve the app; see the privacy policy for details.

items.question: What if I factory reset my phone?
items.answer: CrookCatcher will be uninstalled with a factory reset. We recommend upgrading to Pro and enabling Google Drive backup so your evidence stays safely in the cloud.

items.question: How does CrookCatcher handle my email permissions?
items.answer: CrookCatcher requests Gmail sign-in to send emails on your behalf, avoiding transmission through third-party servers. This permission is limited to sending emails only to your specified address and does not grant access to read emails or manage contacts. You can revoke this permission anytime through your Google Account settings.

items.question: Is there an iPhone version?
items.answer: No, CrookCatcher is available for Android only.
